capabilities: Customize folders from the file explorer context menu
Preview and edit folder mappings in plugin settings
extras: The README references screenshots of the context menu and settings tab that are not included in the text.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that allows you to assign different accent colors and themes to different folders!
problem: Obsidian applies a single accent color and theme to the whole vault, with no way to vary appearance by folder.
summary: Per-folder theming plugin that assigns different accent colors and themes to individual folders in the vault.
